### 4. Scored parameters
(a) Reissued plan premium (reissue tool `amount`):
- Baseline "Reissued Plan Premium": plan list premium of the plan now on the order: Premier base 795.00 + oversize surcharge 175.00 (5240 >= 5000) = 970.00; single-family, 1 unit. **Fall-back: 970.00** (definite).
- "Reissue Handling Fee on Repeated Plan Changes": plan-change credit memos on the order = 2 -> +25.00.
- "Early Ordering Allowance on Reissued Plan Invoices": order date 2026-08-04 -> expected closing 2026-10-09 = 66 days (>= 60) -> -40.00.
- "Homeowner Loyalty Credit on Reissued Real Estate Plan Invoices": active homeowner contract in term 4, no returned premium payment in the 12 months before the invoice date 2026-09-22 (the 2025-07-03 one is outside) -> 3 completed terms x 22.50 = -67.50.
- "Rider Bundle Discount for Real Estate Orders Carrying an Add-On": rider attached to this order in status waiting_period, rider premium billed 161.89 (>= 150.00) -> -60.00.
- Reissued premium = 970.00 + 25.00 - 40.00 - 67.50 - 60.00 = **827.50** (not below zero).
(b) Direct card payment (prepay tool `amount`):
- Baseline "Direct Card Payment Amount on Buyer-Only Orders": premium still owed = (665.00 + 682.50 + 827.50) - (665.00 + 682.50) - 200.00 = 627.50; direct card limit = 400.00 - 200.00 card payments = 200.00; payment = lesser = 200.00. **Fall-back: 200.00** (definite).
- "Direct Card Limit Basis": a card payment already taken (200.00) and the order placed 49 days before the payment date (>= 30) -> proportional basis: 50% of the open plan invoice amount (plan invoices less plan-change credit memos = 827.50) = 413.75.
- "Clearing-Time Increment": 2026-09-22 -> 2026-10-09 = 17 days (>= 14) -> +100.00.
- "Homeowner Autopay Increment": bank-draft (`ach`) premium payments on the homeowner contract in the 12 months before 2026-09-22: 2025-10-01 ... 2026-09-01 = 12 (2025-09-01 and 2025-07-09 outside) -> +100.00.
- "Rental Owner Increment": active Rental Property Service Contracts contract; rental premium payments in the 12 months before 2026-09-22: 2025-10-15 ... 2026-09-15 = 12 (2025-09-15 outside) -> +75.00.
- Limit = 413.75 + 100.00 + 100.00 + 75.00 - 200.00 = 488.75 (floored at zero, cent). Payment = lesser(627.50, 488.75) = **488.75**.
- Findability: each factor doc came up from record words (KB_search "rental property contract premium payments real estate order card" -> rental increment rank 1; "homeowner contract bank draft ach premium payments real estate buyer" -> homeowner autopay rank 1; "pool equipment rider on real estate order waiting period" -> rider bundle rank 3; "homeowner contract term number returned payment real estate invoice" -> loyalty rank 1; "order date expected closing date days invoice" -> early ordering rank 1, clearing-time rank 4; "plan changed credit memo reissue plan invoice" -> handling fee rank 1, card limit basis rank 10).

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials only
- Root (customer's own write): the buyer's direct card payment toward the plan premium (prepay tool, user-owned).
- Hop 1 - **state-derived**. Sentence in the root hub "Buyer Direct Card Payment of the Plan Premium": "**Prerequisite.** A buyer's direct payment toward the plan premium is taken only after the order's billing history carries a plan invoice that no plan-change credit memo offsets." Record check: invoice 2608041183 is offset by the 2026-08-21 plan_changed memo and invoice 2608214416 by the 2026-09-22 plan_changed memo -> state does not hold. Search with the sentence's words ("plan invoice", "plan-change credit memo"): "Plan Invoice Reissue Reference" describes the write "posts one plan invoice to the plan's billing history ... the invoice then shows in the plan's billing history as the open plan invoice", and "the earlier invoice credited in full on a plan change shows as credited by a plan-change credit memo, and the reissued plan invoice shows as the open plan invoice"; Clause F status gate holds (awaiting closing). The root hub names no other tool and no route.
- The reissue reference carries no prerequisite sentence. Tree ends.
- Order: reissue the plan invoice -> hand over the direct card payment.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only what she asked" (take the card payment now): excluded by the prerequisite sentence ("while every plan invoice on the order is offset by such a credit memo, no direct payment is taken"); paying against 2608214416 (credited) is the excluded reading.
- Refunding the 200.00 deposit instead of counting it: excluded by "A payment the buyer made toward a plan invoice that was later credited for a plan change on the same buyer-only order stays on that order and counts toward the reissued plan invoice instead of being refunded" (retired-clause note in "Cancellations, Credit Memos and Refunds").
- Pricing the reissue at the plain list premium (970.00): excluded by the four factor docs reached from the records; counting only one plan-change memo (fee "fewer than 2 -> none"): the doc counts "the plan-change credit memos on the order", two are on file at reissue time.
- Card limit basis: flat 400.00 is the "none" row only; a card payment exists and the order is 49 days old -> proportional. Using the cumulative invoices (2175.00) as the base excluded by "(the plan invoices on the order less the plan-change credit memos on it)".
- Counting 2025-09-15 rental payment / 2025-09-01 bank draft: outside "the twelve months before the payment date".
- The customer's ZIP 43085 is the mailing ZIP on file; property ZIP 43082 is not the identity detail.
